summary: Join our wastewater treatment and reuse training course to gain essential knowledge and skills. Equip yourself for a sustainable future in water management.
lede: Wastewater treatment uses linked processes to reduce contaminants before discharge or reuse. This course is for plant operators and supervisors, utility and environmental health professionals, industrial compliance staff, public-sector sanitation teams, and WASH program managers who make treatment and reuse decisions. It develops skills in interpreting water-quality data, selecting and optimizing treatment steps, managing sludge, and planning fit-for-purpose reuse with monitoring and clear reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals in various sectors who are responsible for wastewater treatment and reuse decisions. If your role involves ensuring compliance, reducing pollution risk, or delivering safe water reuse outcomes, this training is for you.
audience: Water and wastewater treatment plant operators
Environmental health and public health officers
NGO WASH program managers and field coordinators
Facility managers for hospitals, hotels, schools, estates
modules: Wastewater Quality Testing and Data Interpretation
Biological Treatment Options and Operating Logic
Secondary Clarification, Filtration, and Tertiary Polishing
Disinfection and Pathogen Control for Reuse
Wastewater Reuse Planning and Fit-for-Purpose Treatment
Operations, Maintenance, and Process Control Routines
Risk Management, Emergency Response, and Resilience
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of wastewater treatment processes and a role in operations, management, or policy oversight. Familiarity with environmental regulations and basic data interpretation is recommended.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
